crossRefs.note: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed, when he comes in his glory…
But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.
For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be…
The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up…
But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
“I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power…
Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’
He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’
Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’
But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
“But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his…
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.
Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his…

translations.web: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.
translations.bsb: But whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
translations.kjv: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
translations.asv: but he that denieth me in the presence of men shall be denied in the presence of the angels of God.
